_note: Draft English of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Bereshit 5, against the JA. Saadia-specific moves: שרח תיאליד = 'exposition of the offspring' (genealogical preface, cf. B2:4); סלך פי טאעה' אללה = 'walked in obedience to God' (rationalizing substitute for ויתהלך את האלהים — Saadia avoids the literal 'walked WITH God'); v.24 תופי וקבצ'ה אללה = 'he died and God received him' (anti-mystical: explicitly says Enoch died, then God took him); v.29 משקה' אידינא = 'the toil of our hands' (per Blau gloss on עצב/עצבון).

translations.1: This is the exposition of the offspring of Adam. When God created him, in His likeness, sovereign He made him.
translations.2: Male and female He created them; and He blessed them, and named them Adam, on the day He created them.
translations.3: And when Adam had lived a hundred and thirty years, he begot a son in his likeness, after his form; and he named him Seth.
translations.4: And he lived after that eight hundred years, in which he begot sons and daughters.
translations.5: And the whole of his lifetime came to nine hundred and thirty years; and he died.
translations.6: And when Seth had lived a hundred and five years, he begot Enosh.
translations.7: And he lived after that eight hundred and seven years, in which he begot sons and daughters.
translations.8: And the whole of his lifetime came to nine hundred and twelve years; and he died.
translations.10: And he lived after that eight hundred and fifteen years, in which he begot sons and daughters.
translations.11: And the whole of his lifetime came to nine hundred and five years; and he died.
translations.12: And when Kenan had lived seventy years, he begot Mahalalel.
translations.13: And he lived after that eight hundred and forty years, in which he begot sons and daughters.
translations.14: And the whole of his lifetime came to nine hundred and ten years; and he died.
translations.15: And when Mahalalel had lived sixty-five years, he begot Yared.
translations.16: And he lived after that eight hundred and thirty years, in which he begot sons and daughters.
translations.17: And the whole of his lifetime came to eight hundred and ninety-five years; and he died.
translations.18: And when Yared had lived a hundred and sixty-two years, he begot Enoch.
translations.19: And he lived after that eight hundred years, in which he begot sons and daughters.
translations.20: And the whole of his lifetime came to nine hundred and sixty-two years; and he died.
translations.21: And when Enoch had lived sixty-five years, he begot Methuselah.
translations.22: And Enoch walked in obedience to God; after he had begotten Methuselah, three hundred years, in which he begot sons and daughters.
translations.23: And the whole of his lifetime came to three hundred and sixty-five years.
translations.24: And when Enoch had walked in obedience to God — he died, and God received him.
translations.25: And when Methuselah had lived a hundred and eighty-seven years, he begot Lamech.
translations.26: And he lived after that seven hundred and eighty-two years, in which he begot sons and daughters.
translations.27: And the whole of his lifetime came to nine hundred and sixty-nine years; and he died.
translations.28: And when Lamech had lived a hundred and eighty-two years, he begot a son.
translations.29: And he named him Noah, saying: 'This one shall comfort us from our works, and from the toil of our hands, in the earth which God has cursed.'
translations.30: And Lamech lived after that five hundred and ninety-five years, in which he begot sons and daughters.
translations.31: And the whole of his lifetime came to seven hundred and seventy-seven years; and then he died.
translations.32: And when Noah became a son of five hundred years, he begot Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
